camel_example: aliyun ess DescribeLifecycleActions --region cn-hangzhou --LifecycleActionStatus Pending --NextToken AAAAAcSz4VTb1Nq0000 --ScalingActivityId 'asa-bp17mug9t0pegagw0000' --MaxResults 10 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Queries lifecycle tokens by scaling activity ID and status
description_zh: 根据伸缩活动ID和状态查询 Lifecycle Token
kebab_example: aliyun ess describe-lifecycle-actions --scaling-activity-id asa-bp17mug9t0pegagw0000 --lifecycle-action-status Pending --next-token AAAAAcSz4VTb1Nq0000 --max-results 10 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLifecycleActions

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling activity
parameters.name: scaling_activity_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the lifecycle action. Valid values:

Pending: The ECS instance is still in the wait state.
Timeout: The timeout period of the lifecycle hook has been reached, and the wait state of the ECS instance is automatically ended.
Completed: You manually ended the wait state of the ECS instance ahead of schedule
parameters.help_zh:
生命周期操作的状态。取值范围：

Pending：挂起中。表示ECS实例仍处于挂起中状态。
Timeout：已超时。表示已到达生命周期挂钩的超时时间，自动结束ECS实例的挂起中状态。
Completed：已处理。表示您手动提前结束了ECS实例的挂起中状态
parameters.name: lifecycle_action_status

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token that is used to specify the position from which to start the query.

For example, if you queried 10 lifecycle actions in the previous request, you can set this parameter to the value of NextToken returned in the previous response to query lifecycle actions starting from the 11th one. If you do not specify this parameter, the query starts from the beginning
parameters.help_zh:
查询凭证，用于指定开始查询的位置。

例如上次查询10条生命周期操作后，本次从第11条生命周期操作开始查询。取值为上次调用本接口返回的NextToken参数值，如果不填写取值则表示从头开始查询
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
设置单页查询的最大条目数。取值范围：1~50。

默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: region_id

LifecycleAction.description_en: The list of lifecycle actions that correspond to lifecycle hooks
LifecycleAction.description_zh: 各个生命周期挂钩对应的生命周期操作列表

items.description_en: The lifecycle action that corresponds to a lifecycle hook
items.description_zh: 各个生命周期挂钩对应的生命周期操作

InstanceId.description_en: The list of IDs of ECS instances that are suspended by the lifecycle hook
InstanceId.description_zh: 该生命周期挂钩挂起的ECS实例的ID列表

items.description_en: The ID of the ECS instance that is suspended by the lifecycle hook
items.description_zh: 该生命周期挂钩挂起的ECS实例的ID

LifecycleActionResult.description_en:
The next action to take after the lifecycle action triggered by the lifecycle hook is complete. Valid values:

CONTINUE: Auto Scaling continues to respond to a scale-out activity and adds the ECS instance to the scaling group, or continues to respond to a scale-down activity and removes the ECS instance from the scaling group.
ABANDON: Auto Scaling terminates the scale-out activity and releases the created ECS instance, or continues to respond to a scale-down activity and removes the ECS instance from the scaling group
LifecycleActionResult.description_zh:
该生命周期挂钩触发的生命周期操作结束后的下一步动作。取值范围：

CONTINUE：继续响应弹性扩张活动，将ECS实例添加至伸缩组；继续响应弹性收缩活动，将ECS实例从伸缩组移除。
ABANDON：终止弹性扩张活动，直接释放创建出来的ECS实例；继续响应弹性收缩活动，将ECS实例从伸缩组移除

LifecycleActionStatus.description_en: The status of the lifecycle action

LifecycleActionToken.description_en: The identifier of the lifecycle action
LifecycleActionToken.description_zh: 生命周期操作的标识符

LifecycleHookId.description_en: The ID of the lifecycle hook

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries per page
MaxResults.description_zh: 单页查询的最大条目数

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token returned in this response
NextToken.description_zh: 本次调用返回的查询凭证

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of lifecycle actions returned in this query
TotalCount.description_zh: 本次查询到的生命周期操作的总数
